reviews.author: Mihika Joshi
reviews.text: Really good service. Owen helped me out with my shirts and was available around the clock. He even helped me improve the quality of my images that were originally not very good.

reviews.author: Heng Seng “Hengs” Cheah
reviews.text:
The team's super prompt and supportive in a last minute shirt printing request turnaround with both the design and delivery. Quality of the shirt is amazing, and not to mention its easy to deal with the team.

Super grateful and ordering a next batch of shirts as we speak!

reviews.author: Tien Dat Nguyen
reviews.text: Wonderful experience, Owen has been very communicative, responsive and helpful and delivery was way ahead of schedule even though we ordered the shirts last minute in a tight deadline. Shirt quality is excellent and turned out exactly as we hoped for. Price is also very reasonable and much better compared to other supplier. We will definitely work with mysourceofsolutions again in the future. Thank you so much Owen and team!

reviews.author: Meher Bijlani
reviews.text: we were able to get customised shirts within 10 days!! and they are good qualityyy.

reviews.author: Hiya
reviews.text: Absolutely loved the customized shirts! The printing quality was excellent, with sharp details and vibrant colors that came out exactly as expected. The design was really well thought out and looked super cool on everyone.
